about: Raed Gonzalez attended law school and graduated from Universidad Interamericana de Puerto Rico in 1996. Raed Gonzalez began practicing law in 1997.

Raed Gonzalez is an attorney at Gonzalez Olivieri LLC, Immigration Law Firm, helping people with Immigration: Consumer issues. Gonzalez Olivieri LLC, Immigration Law Firm has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Raed Gonzalez was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
